mrn_function: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.assign_and_protect_patient_mrn() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ BEGIN IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN IF OLD.mrn IS NOT NULL AND NEW.mrn IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.mrn THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'patient MRN is immutable'; END IF; IF OLD.mrn IS NULL AND NEW.role::text IN ('user', 'patient') THEN NEW.mrn := 'HMS-' || lpad(nextval('patient_mrn_seq')::text, 8, '0'); ELSIF OLD.mrn IS NULL AND NEW.mrn IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'MRN is reserved for patient records'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END IF; IF NEW.role::text IN ('user', 'patient') THEN IF NEW.mrn IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'patient MRN is database generated'; END IF; NEW.mrn := 'HMS-' || lpad(nextval('patient_mrn_seq')::text, 8, '0'); ELSIF NEW.mrn IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'MRN is reserved for patient records'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END; $function$
mrn_trigger: CREATE TRIGGER users_patient_mrn_guard BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF mrn, role ON public.users FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION assign_and_protect_patient_mrn()
